description: The chart represents the distribution of characters in RoleplayPref across various categories. The pie chart is divided into 13 slices, grouped into three primary categories: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters. Virtual Characters, colored in different shades of blue and comprising approximately 68% of the chart, is further divided into five subcategories: Comic Characters (around 29%), Movie Characters (~11%), Teleplay Characters (~8%), Novel Characters (~9%), and Game Characters (~11%). Custom Characters, colored pink and making up around 17%, is a single subcategory. Real Characters, colored green and accounting for about 15%, is further divided into seven subcategories: Scientists (~3%), Artists (~2%), Athletes (~2%), Writers (~2%), Musicians (~2%), Actors (~2%), and Influencers (~2%). The chart does not include a legend, but the labels are placed inside or adjacent to their respective slices, and the slices are visually distinguishable by color. The segments appear to be ordered by category, with subcategories arranged around their respective primary categories.
